# File

<!-- START TOKEN(Autogenerated block API docs) -->
**Name:** `core/file`
**Category:** [media](/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-media/)
**API Version:** [3](/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-api-versions/)
**Block Type:** [Hybrid](/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/) (static save + server enhancements)

> Add a link to a downloadable file.

**Keywords:** `document`, `pdf`, `download`

## Block Markup

This is a [**hybrid block**](/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/). It saves static markup that the server may enhance during rendering.

```html
<!-- wp:file {"showDownloadButton":true,"previewHeight":600} -->
<!-- Content... -->
<!-- /wp:file -->
```
